claims.text: Oral semaglutide (Wegovy tablets) w a reduced-calorie diet and ↑physical activity:
claims.quote: WEGOVY tablets are indicated in combination with a reduced calorie diet and increased physical activity

claims.text: ↓excess wt and maintain wt loss long term in adults w obesity, or overweight w a wt-related comorbidity.

claims.text: Orforglipron (Foundayo): GLP-1 RA, same use (w diet and ↑activity; adults w obesity, or overweight w a wt-related comorbidity).
claims.quote: GLP-1 receptor agonist indicated in combination with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction long term in adults with obesity or adults with overweight in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition
